description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an FP&A AI Research Contributor based in the United States. 

 We are looking for an experienced Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) professional to contribute industry expertise to the development and evaluation of advanced AI systems. In this fully remote contract role, you will transform your practical experience into realistic financial analysis tasks that help assess how effectively AI can perform the work of an FP&A Analyst. You will create professional assignments using tools and outputs such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, ensuring they reflect real-world business scenarios. By identifying common AI errors and defining clear evaluation criteria, you will help improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated financial work. This opportunity is ideal for finance professionals interested in applying their expertise to emerging AI technologies while enjoying flexible, independent work.

Accountabilities:
 
 Leverage your FP&A expertise to develop realistic, practical tasks that replicate the responsibilities and challenges of financial planning and analysis professionals. Work through each assignment to establish accurate expected outcomes and create objective evaluation criteria that can be used to assess AI-generated results.


 
 Develop realistic FP&A tasks based on your professional experience and everyday financial workflows.



 
 Create domain-specific assignments and deliverables using Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and other relevant professional tools.



 
 Complete each task independently to establish a clear, accurate, and reliable reference answer.



 
 Identify common mistakes and limitations in AI-generated financial analysis and incorporate relevant scenarios into evaluation tasks.



 
 Develop precise yes-or-no evaluation criteria that allow graders to consistently assess the accuracy and quality of AI-generated outputs.



 
 Follow provided project guidelines and collaborate with the research team to ensure tasks meet quality expectations.



 
 Apply attention to detail and professional judgment throughout the task creation and evaluation process.




 Requirements:

 The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in financial planning and analysis, with a strong understanding of financial workflows and the ability to translate professional knowledge into structured, practical assignments. You should be comfortable producing and reviewing financial deliverables, communicating clearly in English, and exploring how AI tools can support or improve finance-related activities.


 
 Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A).



 
 Relevant professional qualifications are valued, including ACCA, CIMA, CPA, CA, or ACA.



 
 Strong written English communication skills and the ability to explain complex financial concepts clearly.



 
 Practical experience using financial tools and producing professional deliverables in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.



 
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and gaps in financial outputs.



 
 Willingness to learn about artificial intelligence, AI evaluation methodologies, and emerging concepts in AI assessments.



 
 Ability to develop structured tasks and objective evaluation criteria.



 
 Familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems is an advantage.



 
 Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and deliver high-quality assignments within the required timelines.




 Benefits:


 
 Fully remote independent contractor opportunity.



 
 Flexible working schedule, allowing you to complete tasks on your own schedule.



 
 Immediate start available.



 
 Initial project duration of approximately 4–6 weeks.



 
 Task-based compensation, with payment issued weekly following task completion.



 
 Opportunity to qualify for additional assignments throughout the project after successfully completing the first task within the required timeline.



 
 Potential for project extensions depending on business needs and individual performance.



 
 Opportunity to apply your FP&A expertise to real-world AI training and evaluation initiatives.



 
 Exposure to emerging AI technologies and professional AI assessment methodologies.



 
 No requirement to access confidential or proprietary information belonging to current or previous employers, clients, or institutions.
